listing.name: Haze — Haze Recomp (zdiemer)
listing.summary: Upstream demonstrates menus, opening gameplay, audio and checkpoints. A full campaign is unconfirmed; co-op uses two local instances only. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA BLUS30094 disc 01.02, application 01.00 ISO. The upstream installer downloads an RPCS3 helper and Sony firmware; review that setup before running it.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow HazeRecomp Setup.exe to install the per-user MSI and use the launcher to prepare your own ISO.

warnings: Upstream demonstrates menus, opening gameplay, audio and checkpoints. A full campaign is unconfirmed; co-op uses two local instances only.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
